title: SignalEvidence
description: One piece of evidence for one buying/timing signal on one business, V3.1.1. Multiple SignalEvidence items for the same signal_type + prospect are resolved deterministically (scripts/signal_evidence.py: resolve_signals) into the flat prospect fields V3.1's score_fit already consumes -- this object is the auditable trail behind that resolution, never a replacement for it. UNKNOWN != FALSE: a signal with no evidence at all simply has no SignalEvidence object, not one with value=false.

signal_type.description: Extensible -- any string is accepted so a new signal never requires a schema change. Known types: runs_google_ads, runs_lsa, recent_expansion, new_location, marketing_hiring_signal, review_velocity_signal, recent_site_investment, new_high_value_service, multiple_locations. paid_search_organic_gap is NOT a signal_type here -- it is always derived (see scripts/signal_evidence.py: derive_paid_search_organic_gap), never independently evidenced.

value.description: true/false for boolean signals; a string (e.g. STRONG/MODERATE/LOW) for review_velocity_signal; null if this evidence item itself couldn't determine a value (rare -- usually you just wouldn't create the item)

confidence.description: How confident THIS evidence item is, independent of source-type trust -- see config/signal_sources.yaml for how source_type interacts with this

source.description: The specific URL/reference this evidence came from

observed_at.description: When THIS evidence was actually gathered/observed -- freshness is computed from here, never manufactured

published_at.description: When the underlying fact was published/dated, if known and different from observed_at (e.g. a news article's publish date)

freshness_days.description: Computed at resolution time (days between observed_at/published_at and now) -- not set by the evidence gatherer, filled in by scripts/signal_evidence.py

evidence.description: The specific, checkable observation -- never a generic statement

entity_match_confidence.description: How confident this evidence is actually about THIS business (name/domain/phone/address/city cross-check), not a same-named or nearby business
